narr: As a cold front moved through the region, several rounds of showers and storms moved across portions of northern Missouri into west central Illinois. There were a couple of reports of flash flooding during the evening of June 30th through the morning hours of July 1st.
ev: Up to 4 inches of rain fell in a about a 2 hour period causing flash flooding across the southern half of Boone County. A water rescue occurred about 4 miles east northeast of McBaine. Numerous roads were flooded. No injuries were reported.
